About this item
【APPLICATION MODELS】The MY1020 DC electric bike motor compatible with scooter, quad go cart, e-bike, mini bikes. (*Please confirm your model before you make the order.)
【SPECIFICATION】①Model: ZY1020G and MY1020; ②Voltage:48 Volts; ③Horsepower: 1000 Watts；④Sprocket: 11 teeth sprocket for 25H chain; ⑤Output speed: 3000 rpm; ⑥Motor type: Brushed high speed.

【11T SPROCKET #25 CHAIN】This 1000W electric motor for e-bike is fitted with a #25 industrial roller chain, a widely available size that makes replacements or drive adjustments easy—you can source parts at most hardware stores or bicycle shops.
【POWERFUL 1000W OUTPUT】The MY1020 11t reversible motor delivers powerful starting torque, enabling your electric bike to accelerate rapidly from a complete stop. This robust initial thrust ensures quick, confident launches whether you're on flat ground or beginning an incline.
